title: Type 96 25 mm twin AA gun in its emplacement
make: const t = __target('aa25'); const g = AA.gun.find((g) => g.t === t); if (g && g.bar) window.__M['Barrel group length'] = __size(g.bar).x; return __local(t.m, g && g.grp && g.grp !== t.m && !t.m.children.includes(g.grp) ? [g.grp] : []);

ref: barrel 1.5 m (L/60); the whole gun with its receiver is longer (War Thunder wiki; Wikipedia)
notes: Twin mount weight 1,100 kg (NavWeaps).
